- File: scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py
  Line or code reference: Line 323 in _run_gh_api method
  Problem: Invalid GitHub API Accept header media type "application/vnd.github.raw+json" is used for raw content retrieval.
  Why it fails at runtime: According to GitHub REST API documentation for the Contents endpoint, the valid media type for raw content is "application/vnd.github.v3.raw" (or "application/vnd.github.raw"), not "application/vnd.github.raw+json". When an invalid media type is requested, the API may fall back to the default JSON response format containing base64-encoded content metadata instead of the raw file text. The script expects plaintext for diff comparison, so this would cause drift detection to fail because the "actual" content would be JSON metadata rather than the workflow file content.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Problem: The raw-content media type `application/vnd.github.raw+json` is not a documented GitHub Contents API media type. The supported raw variant is `application/vnd.github.v3.raw`.
  Why it fails at runtime: An unsupported media type typically causes the API to return the default JSON metadata response (with base64-encoded content) instead of raw plaintext. The script never base64-decodes, so every `fetch_workflow_content` call would receive non-YAML text, causing every consumer wrapper to be reported as drift (false positives on every run).
